web_fixture.title: TRD-1094: coldshard - tiderail error index
web_fixture.snippet: TRD-1094 reports a coldshard: a cache region that never warmed after a worker restart, so the worker serves from the origin until it does.
web_fixture.content:
# tiderail error index

Errors print as TRD-NNNN and are grouped by subsystem. The condition names below are what our dashboards show.

## Cache region

| Code | Condition | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TRD-2211 | hotloop | A region is being re-read faster than it can be filled. Usually a hot key. |
| TRD-1094 | coldshard | A cache region never warmed after a worker restart; the worker serves from the origin until it does. |
| TRD-1088 | thinmoss | The region's fill rate sits below the health floor. |

Last reviewed 2026-04-21.

web_fixture.title: Warmup tuning thread: hotloop on every deploy
web_fixture.snippet: Every deploy, one shard goes hotloop before it settles. Our tuning notes follow.
web_fixture.content:
# Warmup tuning thread: hotloop on every deploy

**posted 2026-02-11 by Priyanka Sorensen**

After each deploy we get a burst of TRD-2211 (hotloop) on the busiest shard: the region is re-read faster than it can be filled. We raised the fill concurrency and the burst shrank.

**replied 2026-02-12 by Callum Deveraux**

If a region never fills at all, that is the other cache-region code, not this one; the error index lists both conditions side by side.

web_fixture.title: Smaller probes, fewer false alarms
web_fixture.snippet: We halved probe intervals and cut false unhealthy markings by a third.
web_fixture.content:
# Smaller probes, fewer false alarms

Long probe intervals made healthy workers look dead for minutes at a time. We cut the interval and the false-unhealthy rate fell by a third.

This change did not add or rename any error code; the index page stays the reference for names.

Published 2026-03-19.
